evals.prompt: Create a TTSR rule for local://*-plan.md writes so the model remembers plan-file conventions when writing plan artifacts.
evals.expected_output: A rule design that uses scope/path matching for the write target instead of trying to detect the destination path from the write body.
assertions: The response chooses scope or path matching over content regex for local://*-plan.md writes
The response treats the rule as TTSR-capable rather than always-apply by default
The response mentions at least one negative or near-miss trigger check

evals.prompt: Refine a rule that currently triggers on plans?\b and keeps interrupting incidental prose about plans.
evals.expected_output: A refinement that narrows condition and scope, and explicitly validates both positive and negative trigger cases.
assertions: The response narrows the over-broad plans?\b trigger
The response requires at least one negative case or near-miss check
The response reviews condition and scope together rather than only editing regex text

evals.prompt: Clean up duplicate plan rules across OMP and Cursor providers after a migration.
evals.expected_output: A cleanup plan that verifies provider precedence and the kept copy before deleting or disabling duplicates.
assertions: The response verifies provider precedence or kept copy before deletion
The response avoids deleting duplicates before confirming which copy wins
The response preserves the active rule path or name while removing stale duplicates
